text: Skip: UIA capture, click-outside-to-close, MCP tool. Risk: 2000+ char text may exceed the 55s timeout, and the plugin settings page has not been verified in a real magpie plugin add. The helper streams translation, caches results in memory, and restores the clipboard after picking. Popover is a plain Win32 window with no focus stealing. Terminal, conhost, mstsc and password managers are blacklisted so Ctrl+C is never synthesized there. Glossary lines are appended to the user message, never to the system prompt, so the gateway prefix cache stays intact. Logging records only timings and character counts, never the source text.
